quickjs-ng, vendored for VaCuusJs
=================================

upstream: https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs
tag:      v0.17.0
commit:   6d46d07d04041b40f4f49eaa7fdebe44c314c699
vendored: 2026-10-20

Core-only source set
--------------------
The core library compiles quickjs.c, libregexp.c, libunicode.c and dtoa.c.
The accompanying upstream headers are copied without modification:

    quickjs.h quickjs-atom.h quickjs-opcode.h quickjs-c-atomics.h
    cutils.h list.h libregexp.h libregexp-opcode.h
    libunicode.h libunicode-table.h dtoa.h
    builtin-array-fromasync.h builtin-iterator-zip.h builtin-iterator-zip-keyed.h

LICENSE and the notices in the individual files travel with the source.
The builtin headers are upstream's pre-generated bytecode for this exact tag;
update them together with the engine. No build-time code generation is needed.
quickjs-libc, the CLI, tests and docs are intentionally not compiled or vendored.
VaCuus implements console, timers and requestAnimationFrame itself.

Build contract
--------------
VaCuusJs.Build.cs compiles C11 with _GNU_SOURCE and, on Win64,
WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN. UBT supplies the Windows API floor. Neither
BUILDING_QJS_SHARED nor USING_QJS_SHARED is defined: this is a static-style embed.
Regenerate Source/VaCuusJs/Private/Gen with Source/VaCuusJs/gen_relays.sh.

Local patches
-------------
None. Former patch #1 (GNU JS_EXTERN visibility) was retired on 2026-10-20.
Upstream PR #1525, released in 0.16.0, gates default visibility on
BUILDING_QJS_SHARED; v0.17.0 includes the fix. Do not reapply the old patch.
After a Linux modular build, nm -D on libUnrealEditor-VaCuusJs.so must still
list no JS_* symbols. All files except this provenance note are byte-identical
to the pinned tag.
